candidates.statement: Payment authorization calls from order time out (ReadTimeout, ~2s), causing order and checkout to return 502; gateway checkout shows 502s at ~2s with p95 ~2425ms. Inventory/redis calls succeed, so the fault is downstream payment latency.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side metrics/logs admitted; payment latency root cause (e.g. saturation) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show repeated payment POST /v1/authorizations ReadTimeout errors propagating to order and checkout 502s, while inventory/redis succeed. Gateway metrics show 16 checkout 502s and p95 ~2425ms. Bounded candidate: downstream payment latency.
missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics and logs to confirm the timeout source
Payment dependency topology and resource saturation data
